## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **Male G6PD Normal** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Medical supervision |
| **Female G6PD Normal** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Medical supervision |
| **G6PD Deficient** | No PQ or PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Close medical supervision with access to blood transfusion |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Close medical supervision |
